profile.summary: The Mosaic Project is an Oakland-based nonprofit that teaches people, from elementary school students to adults in the workplace, skills for building peaceful communities. Its programs include an outdoor program, in-school programs with assemblies and classroom workshops, youth leadership, family camps, and workshops for teachers and parents. The programs focus on equity, empathy and effective communication.
